milestone: Phase 1.1.2.2.4.2 — Independent Audit Correctness & Post-Merge Verification
reverse_engineering_scoping_rationale: Phase 1 acceptance criteria establish PE metadata, dependency reconciliation, and verification integrity; no native binary decompilation or Ghidra execution is required.

criteria.title: PR #7 Baseline Merge Commit Object Resolution
criteria.semantic_justification: Resolves PR #7 merge commit 55ea077a47099a97f839e0d878934088a3a4e0e0 in Git object database via git cat-file.

criteria.title: PR #7 Merge Tree SHA Resolution
criteria.semantic_justification: Independently computes and verifies PR #7 merge tree SHA 023ddda8ac3f61e49de429ed6e236f9be159105d.

criteria.title: Final Merge & Sealing Commit Tree Equivalence
criteria.semantic_justification: Verifies TREE_EQUIVALENT between PR #7 merge commit 55ea077 and sealing commit 07bc314 (both tree 023ddda...).

criteria.title: Mandatory Lifecycle Fields in Provenance
criteria.semantic_justification: Ensures commit, tree, author, committer, and parent relationship fields are mandatory in provenance documents.

criteria.title: Provenance Validated Revision Match
criteria.semantic_justification: Verifies that the provenance revision matches the exact commit and tree validated during execution.

criteria.title: Full Working-Tree Cleanliness (Zero Exclusions)
criteria.semantic_justification: Executes git status --porcelain with zero directory or file exclusions; requires exactly 0 dirty lines.

criteria.title: Fresh Execution Against Validated Revision
criteria.semantic_justification: Verifies fresh execution run against current validated revision with complete lifecycle start and end timestamps.

criteria.title: Windows Runtime Platform Verification
criteria.semantic_justification: Verifies that execution environment is win32 on Windows 10 x64, matching production target requirements.

criteria.title: Consistent Run ID Propagation
criteria.semantic_justification: Ensures single unique run ID is shared across manifest, stdout/stderr artifacts, audit, and gate results.

criteria.title: Complete Execution Log Artifact Availability
criteria.semantic_justification: Verifies that stdout.log, stderr.log, regression.stdout.txt, and regression.stderr.txt exist on disk.

criteria.title: Execution Artifact SHA-256 and Byte Size Verification
criteria.semantic_justification: Recomputes SHA-256 hashes and byte lengths directly from disk and compares against declared manifest values.

criteria.title: Artifact Path Containment & Symlink Safety
criteria.semantic_justification: Enforces os.path.commonpath containment within REPO_ROOT and requires os.path.islink is False for all paths.

criteria.title: Authoritative 13-Field Check Schema Compliance
criteria.semantic_justification: Ensures every check record possesses all 13 canonical schema fields, unique check_id, and valid status token.

criteria.title: Global Totals Derived from Validation Records
criteria.semantic_justification: Asserts mathematical equality between raw record counts and overall accounting summary totals.

criteria.title: Stage Accounting Reconciliation
criteria.semantic_justification: Verifies that the sum of checks across all 10 registered stages exactly equals total checks.

criteria.title: Claim Classification Reconciliation
criteria.semantic_justification: Reconciles claim status classifications (VERIFIED, INFERRED, UNAVAILABLE, UNVERIFIED) across all artifacts.

criteria.title: P1-015 Physical Missing vs Obsolete Classification
criteria.semantic_justification: Ensures physically missing modules and obsolete placeholder DLLs remain distinctly categorized.

criteria.title: P1-020 .NET Runtime Behavior Scoping
criteria.semantic_justification: Verifies that static IL analysis of .NET assemblies is not overstated as live runtime behavior.

criteria.title: P1-022 WCF Licensing Scoping Verification
criteria.semantic_justification: Verifies that licensing assembly presence is not overstated as active WCF runtime execution proof.

criteria.title: Regression & Adversarial Suite Real Execution
criteria.semantic_justification: Executes all unit and adversarial regression tests in clean subprocess, verifying exit code 0.

criteria.title: Truthful CI Status Reporting (UNAVAILABLE)
criteria.semantic_justification: Formally records CI status as UNAVAILABLE; prohibits false PASS claims when remote CI was not run.

criteria.title: Independent Release Gate Fail-Closed Evaluation
criteria.semantic_justification: Enforces fail-closed evaluation: release gate yields ACCEPTED only when all 10 release gates pass.
